model_evidence_lines: [Perf] tune a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle for DSv4-Pro shapes on MI355X
Tune the a8w8 blockscale **bpreshuffle** GEMM configs used by DeepSeek-V4 on gfx950 (MI355X, cu_num=256), updating `aiter/configs/model_configs/dsv4_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned_gemm.csv`.

68 M values per shape (1, 2, 4, 8 + \`getPaddedM\` gl=0 fine-grained set covering 16..2048, plus sparse {4096, 6144, 8192, 10240, 12288, 14336, 16384, 32768}). Tuned across ck/cktile/asm backends with \`--libtype all\`, 204 rows, 0 failures. ~6.5 min on 8x MI355X.
Tuned with \`--libtype all\` (ck/cktile/asm), 75/75 success, ~6 min on 8x MI355X.

All 60 rows are in-place replacements of existing keys (no rows added). Each new kernel was chosen with the official tuner (--libtype all, --preshuffle) and kept only when a multi-run ABBA head-to-head on MI355X gfx950 (50 warmup / 200 iters / 7 groups, median) confirmed >2% speedup over the previous kernel with bit- identical output (maxdiff=0). Most are CK 256x64x256x128 -> CKTile 192x256x128.

Re-tuned DSv4 FP8 a8w8 blockscale bpreshuffle GEMM configs for gfx950 (MI355, 256 CUs). 43 shapes improved across all batch sizes (M=1-32768), primarily by switching from CK `intrawave_v1` to ASM splitK kernels.
